pages.title: Hello Summer Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling sun fills this printable coloring page above a three-turret sandcastle, striped beach ball, scallop shell, and spiral shell on the sand. The castle has an arched doorway, small windows, and a flag, while the sun's broad rays form large enclosed spaces in the summer coloring sheet.

pages.title: Summer Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a summer beach with a coconut palm, open umbrella, beach ball, scallop shell, calm ocean waves, and sunshine. A low sandbank divides the foreground from the water, and the large shell sits below the umbrella without overlapping the palm's segmented trunk.

pages.title: Sandcastle Coloring Page
pages.description: A three-turret sandcastle rises from a shallow moat in this printable coloring page, with an arched entrance, small windows, a flag, and shell decorations. The central tower stands above two shorter turrets, while a starfish shape and scallop shell decorate the broad front wall of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Beach Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: A large striped beach ball rests on the sand in this printable coloring page, with curved panels meeting at a round patch near the top. A short ocean horizon and a few wave lines sit behind it, leaving the ball's broad sections as the main areas to color.

pages.title: Beach Chair and Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: An empty beach chair sits beneath an open umbrella in this printable coloring page, with striped fabric, folding supports, and a long pole planted in sand. The umbrella's scalloped edge separates broad canopy panels, while the chair's crossbars and pivot joints add smaller spaces below its curved seat.

pages.title: Sand Bucket and Shovel Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling sand bucket stands beside a toy shovel in this printable coloring page, with a curved handle, round attachments, and wavy bands across its front. The shovel has a broad scoop and an open grip, and both beach toys rest together on a small outlined mound of sand.

pages.title: Flip Flops Coloring Page
pages.description: Two flower-decorated flip flops fill this printable coloring page, showing broad soles, branching straps, and matching blossoms near the toes and heels of each sandal. The pair sits side by side without a surrounding scene, leaving large open areas between the straps, flower petals, and rounded outer edges.

pages.title: Sunglasses Coloring Page
pages.description: One large pair of sunglasses fills this printable coloring page, with rounded rectangular lenses, a curved nose bridge, small oval hinges, and folded-back arms. The empty lens interiors form the largest coloring areas, while the outlined frame and curved earpieces provide narrower sections around the outside of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Sun Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A broad-brimmed sun hat fills this printable coloring page, with a rounded crown, wide ribbon band, five-petaled flower, and two pointed ribbon tails. The brim curves around the crown in a continuous outline, leaving open sections across the hat and smaller enclosed shapes within its flower decoration.

pages.title: Smiling Sun Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling sun fills this printable coloring page, with rounded wavy rays, arched eyebrows, outlined cheeks, and an open mouth divided by a tongue curve. The face occupies the center of the sun, and the surrounding ray shapes remain broad and separate against an otherwise empty white background.

pages.title: Palm Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A coconut palm stands alone in this printable coloring page, with broad spreading fronds, two coconuts, a curved segmented trunk, and grass around its base. Long interior curves follow the leaves, while the bands across the trunk divide its tall shape into smaller enclosed areas without adding a busy background.

pages.title: Seashells Coloring Page
pages.description: Three seashells overlap in this printable coloring page: a large fan-shaped scallop, a round spiral shell, and a pointed conch with a broad opening. Curved bands follow the spiral and tapered shell, while long ribs divide the scallop into wide sections across the upper part of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Crab on the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling crab stands on a sandy patch in this printable coloring page, with raised claws, stalked eyes, eight walking legs, and a rounded shell. Joint lines divide the legs and claw arms, while a scallop shell, starfish, and a few small pebbles sit beneath the crab.

pages.title: Starfish Coloring Page
pages.description: A five-armed starfish rests on the sand in this printable coloring page, with a smiling face and rows of outlined circles along its arms. Broad rounded tips define the starfish's silhouette, while a few short sand lines leave the surrounding beach area open in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ice Cream Cone Coloring Page
pages.description: Three smiling ice cream scoops sit in one waffle cone in this printable coloring page, with one scoop above two others and small curved highlights. The scoops have scalloped lower edges, and diagonal lines cross the cone to create large diamond-shaped sections beneath the rounded ice cream shapes.

pages.title: Popsicle Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling popsicles stand side by side in this printable coloring page, with dripping toppings, rounded wooden sticks, and a citrus-slice decoration on one pop. Their slightly tilted outlines overlap at the center, leaving broad areas inside the frozen treats and smaller sections within the fruit design.

pages.title: Lemonade Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling glass of lemonade fills this printable coloring page, with ice cubes, a striped straw, a lemon slice on the rim, and a whole lemon. The drink's surface forms a wavy line inside the glass, while an outlined leaf adds another broad shape beside the foreground fruit.

pages.title: Lemonade Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: A lemonade stand fills this printable coloring page, with a striped awning, pitcher, two drinking glasses, whole lemons, a lemon slice, and triangular bunting. Upright posts support the canopy above the counter, while broad vertical panels form the front of the stand in the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ice Cream Truck Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling ice cream truck fills this printable coloring page, with a large cone-shaped roof sign, side serving window, striped awning, mirrors, and outlined wheels. The front has round headlights and a broad bumper, while open body panels leave larger coloring areas beneath the smaller serving-window details.

pages.title: Watermelon Slice Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling watermelon slice fills this printable coloring page, with a pointed top, broad curved rind, outlined teardrop-shaped seeds, and rounded cheeks beside its face. The rind forms a separate band along the lower edge, while the wide triangular fruit section remains open between the scattered seed shapes.

pages.title: Pineapple Coloring Page
pages.description: A complete pineapple fills this printable coloring page, with a tall crown of pointed leaves, a smiling face, and crossing diagonal lines across its oval body. The overlapping leaves create broad separate shapes above the fruit, while the lower lattice pattern forms large diamond sections around the face.

pages.title: Coconut Drink Coloring Page
pages.description: A coconut drink fills this printable coloring page, with a bent straw, small paper umbrella, smiling face, and a hibiscus flower beside the shell. A thick outlined rim surrounds the drink opening, while curved shell marks and the flower's broad petals add separate areas across the lower half.

pages.title: Summer Fruit Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer fruit basket fills this printable coloring page, with a watermelon wedge, bunch of grapes, strawberries, and round leafy fruit beneath an arched handle. The basket has wide woven bands, while outlined seeds, strawberry leaves, and individual grapes provide smaller details between the larger fruit shapes.

pages.title: Swimming Pool Coloring Page
pages.description: A child floats inside a striped swim ring in this printable coloring page, resting both hands over the front while smiling in a swimming pool. The ring surrounds the child's upper body, and a curved tiled pool edge and several simple water lines complete the summer coloring sheet.

pages.title: Surfing Coloring Page
pages.description: A child balances on a surfboard in this printable coloring page, wearing a short-sleeved shirt and drawstring shorts with arms extended above a gentle wave. Both bare feet rest apart on the board, while the curling water and a few splash shapes leave the main surfing pose clearly visible.

pages.title: Snorkeling Coloring Page
pages.description: A child snorkels above two fish in this printable coloring page, wearing a large mask, curved breathing tube, short swimwear, and flippers on both feet. The figure floats diagonally over a sparse reef, with outlined bubbles, rocks, coral, and seaweed surrounding the open underwater space.

pages.title: Water Slide Coloring Page
pages.description: A child slides feet first into a splash pool in this printable coloring page, with raised hands, drawstring shorts, bare feet, and an outlined smile. The complete slide curves down from a ladder behind the child, while broad splash shapes surround the feet above the rounded pool rim.

pages.title: Flamingo Pool Float Coloring Page
pages.description: An empty flamingo pool float fills this printable coloring page, with a long curved neck, smiling beak, outlined wings, and an open circular seat. The inflatable body rests on simple water lines, with a low tiled pool edge and a few rounded bushes in the background.

pages.title: Sailboat Coloring Page
pages.description: A small smiling sailboat floats on broad waves in this printable coloring page, with a tall mast, one triangular sail, and a horizontal boom. The rounded hull has a broad rim and a simple face, while the sail's large open interior contrasts with the narrow mast and supporting lines.

pages.title: Kayaking Coloring Page
pages.description: A child paddles a kayak in this printable coloring page, wearing a buckled life jacket and holding one double-ended paddle above a calm river. The knees sit within the cockpit, and crossed deck cords form smaller sections on the pointed bow beneath the larger paddle blades.

pages.title: Fishing at the Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: A child fishes from a grassy lake bank in this printable coloring page, holding a curved rod with a reel and a line reaching the water. Bent knees, socks, and sneakers define the seated pose, while a foreground rock and circular ripples add details around the open lake.

pages.title: Camping Tent Coloring Page
pages.description: An open camping tent fills this printable coloring page, with tied-back entrance flaps, curved support lines, a rolled sleeping bag, and two pine trees behind it. Wide straps secure the sleeping roll, while a few stones and small grass tufts leave the campsite's foreground mostly open.

pages.title: Roasting Marshmallows Coloring Page
pages.description: A child roasts a marshmallow beside a campfire in this printable coloring page, sitting cross-legged in a hooded sweatshirt and sneakers while holding one long stick. Outlined flames rise from a ring of stones, with a simple tent behind the child and broad open areas across the clothing.

pages.title: Summer Picnic Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer picnic fills this printable coloring page, with a woven basket, lemonade pitcher, drinking glass, two sandwiches, and a watermelon wedge on a checked blanket. The basket's arched handle rises above a folded cloth, while outlined lemon slices, ice cubes, and sandwich layers provide smaller details.

pages.title: Backyard Barbecue Coloring Page
pages.description: An open barbecue grill fills this printable coloring page, with two corn cobs, two burger patties, a raised lid, side handles, and outlined wheels. A plate and slotted spatula rest on a nearby table, while a simple fence and bushes frame the backyard cooking scene.

pages.title: Flying a Kite Coloring Page
pages.description: A child flies a diamond-shaped kite in this printable coloring page, holding its curved string while standing in a shirt, shorts, socks, and sneakers. Crossed supports divide the kite into broad sections, and two trailing ribbons curve away from its lower point above the open grassy setting.

pages.title: Riding a Bike Coloring Page
pages.description: A child rides a bicycle in this printable coloring page, gripping the curved handlebars with both hands while placing sneakered feet on the two pedals. The bicycle's frame, saddle, wheels, and spokes remain clearly outlined, with only a few bushes and curved path lines around the rider.

pages.title: Water Balloon Fight Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children play with water balloons in this printable coloring page, with one holding a balloon and the other tossing another above a bucket. Their shirts, shorts, and sneakers form broad coloring areas, while tied balloon ends and the bucket's curved handle provide smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Playing in the Sprinkler Coloring Page
pages.description: A barefoot child runs through a garden sprinkler in this printable coloring page, spreading both arms while one leg bends behind the body above the grass. Long arcs of water rise from the low sprinkler, with outlined droplets, a connected hose, and a few bushes around the summer activity.

pages.title: Blowing Bubbles Coloring Page
pages.description: A child blows bubbles in this printable coloring page, holding a round wand near pursed lips and an open bottle in the other hand. A bow, ponytail, pleated skirt, socks, and sneakers add clothing details, while several large outlined bubbles fill the open space beside the figure.

pages.title: Hammock Coloring Page
pages.description: An empty hammock hangs between two coconut palms in this printable coloring page, with visible rope knots, hanging loops, segmented trunks, and broad spreading fronds. Long curved lines define the fabric's sagging center, leaving a wide open section between the supporting trees and their small grass patches.

pages.title: Summer Road Trip Coloring Page
pages.description: Two travelers take a coastal road trip in this printable coloring page, riding in an open convertible with a suitcase behind the seats and ocean beyond. Rounded headlights, wheels, mirrors, and body panels define the car, while a palm tree and small sailboat establish the seaside setting.

pages.title: Summer Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer garden fills this printable coloring page, with two large smiling flowers, a watering can, tomatoes, carrots, a picket fence, and an outlined sun. Broad petals and leaves surround the can, while its handle, spout, and perforated sprinkler head provide smaller shapes among the vegetables.

pages.title: Sunflower Coloring Page
pages.description: A large sunflower fills this printable coloring page, with pointed petals around a round center, widely spaced outlined seeds, a complete stem, and two leaves. Interior curves divide the leaves, while the broad petals and open spaces between the seed shapes keep the flower's main sections distinct.

pages.title: Butterfly on a Flower Coloring Page
pages.description: A butterfly perches on a broad flower in this printable coloring page, with patterned wings, two curved antennae, a smiling face, and legs touching the center. Rounded spots and long enclosed wing shapes contrast with the flower's wide petals, while two leaves extend from the stem below.

pages.title: Bee on a Flower Coloring Page
pages.description: A bee rests on a flower in this printable coloring page, with antennae, outlined wings, jointed legs, a smiling face, and broad bands across its abdomen. The stripes remain open for coloring, while the flower's rounded petals and two large leaves form additional sections beneath the insect.

pages.title: Firefly Jar Coloring Page
pages.description: Four fireflies surround an open glass jar in this printable coloring page, with two flying above the rim and two visible inside its unshaded walls. Antennae, wings, striped abdomens, and small light rays distinguish the insects, while the jar's broad outline leaves open space around them.

pages.title: Lighthouse Coloring Page
pages.description: A seaside lighthouse fills this printable coloring page, with a domed lantern room, balcony railing, arched window, striped tower, and rounded doorway above shoreline rocks. A simple face decorates the lower tower, while broad waves, two clouds, and an outlined sun complete the open coastal scene.

pages.title: Summer Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer mandala fills this printable coloring page, with a smiling central sun surrounded by watermelon slices, two ice cream cones, scallop shells, and paired leaves. The motifs sit within one broad circular outline, leaving open areas between the large shapes and smaller sections inside the fruit and shells.
